src/outbox-service.ts.name: Outbox service
src/outbox-service.ts.description: Answers napplet outbox lookups, queries, subscriptions and publishes by handing them to a relay router.

src/relay-pool-outbox-planning.ts.name: Relay planning
src/relay-pool-outbox-planning.ts.description: Works out which relays to ask from authors' published relay lists, filtered by the shell's relay rules, falling back to host relays and adding allowed relay hints.

src/relay-pool-outbox-router.ts.name: Outbox relay router
src/relay-pool-outbox-router.ts.description: The ready-made router that finds authors' relays and reads or publishes through a relay pool, streaming events as they arrive.

src/relay-pool-outbox-types.ts.name: Outbox router shapes
src/relay-pool-outbox-types.ts.description: Describes the relay lists, relay pool and options the outbox router works with.
